assessment: Through the cell selective deletion in bone marrow marrow adipocytes (BMAds) of an enzyme for lipolysis, the authors demonstrate elegantly a role for this pathway in the maintenance of hematopoiesis and bone mass during periods of caloric stress, injury and energy restriction. This study establishes for the first time a role for the bone marrow adipocyte in energy balance.
